name: dobe_back_faceless
desc: This goo monster seen from behind: make it a still-forming faceless goo humanoid. Remove the ears and the snout completely: the head becomes a smooth rounded lump of thick dripping pink paint goo on the thick neck. Keep the huge broad back, shoulders, arms, size, pose and puddle, but wetter and more melted: thick goo sagging and dripping everywhere, sticky. Same colors, yellow marble streaks, outline and pixel art style.
